items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Tech Mahindra, Infosys lead 300-pt gain in Sensex; SMIDs trade mixed
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Friday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap and the Nifty SmallCap fell 0.19 per cent and 0.14 per cent, respectively

items.title: Silver outlook bearish; may fall to $48 if $54.50 support breaks: Analyst
items.description: Praveen Singh of Mirae Asset Sharekhan said that silver has fallen quite sharply in the last few weeks. The white metal looks weaker than gold, as ETF flows are not inspiring.

items.title: Sell gold on rallies as rate hike concerns weigh: Mirae Asset Sharekhan
items.description: Praveen Singh of Mirae Asset Sharekhan has said that spot gold is facing tremendous selling pressure on rate hike concerns as inflation continues to run hot. It is advisable to sell into rallies.

items.title: Asian stocks rebound after tech sell-off; Indonesia market plunges 11%
items.description: Japan's Nikkei and South Korea's KOSPI recover after steep losses as concerns over AI financing weigh on sentiment, while MSCI's move to downgrade Indonesia's market status triggers a sharp sell-off

items.title: Jio Financial shares drop 2.5% as Q2 PAT halves; MOFSL cuts FY27 estimates
items.description: Jio Financial share: Analysts at Motilal Oswal Financial Services said healthy execution continued to drive growth, but higher provisions prompted earnings estimates cut for FY27.

items.title: Nifty IT soars 14% in 6 days on Q2 earnings boost; TechM, Wipro, TCS shine
items.description: At 10:12 AM on Friday, the Nifty IT index was the top sectoral gainer, up 2.8%. Tech Mahindra, Wipro, Infosys and TCS surged up to 7% amid Q2 earnings cheer.

items.title: HDFC Life Insurance sheds 3% post Q2 results; brokerages remain upbeat
items.description: Analysts at Systematix Institutional Research and Elara Securities retained a 'Buy' rating on HDFC Life stock, highlighting that Value of New Business in Q2 came in ahead of Q2 estimates.

items.title: Cyient DLM tanks 19% on huge volumes post Q2 results; here's why
items.description: Cyient DLM's Q2 earnings showed that execution was slightly impacted by supply chain lead times and margins were softer while the order book was strong.

items.title: Gold ETFs hold firm, gain up to 1% despite mutual fund investment curbs
items.description: Fresh lump-sum investments, new SIP registrations and SIP step-ups in these FoFs have been suspended, while existing SIPs will continue as usual.

items.title: Indian software stocks set to outperform AI peers by most margin in decades
items.description: India's top software exporters have surged over 10% this week as global chip stocks fall 7.4%, with analysts pointing to AI valuation concerns and signs of improving revenue growth in the IT sector

items.title: Q2 impact: TechM shares gain 8% as analysts raise earnings estimate, target
items.description: Tech Mahindra shares jumped 5 per cent and emerged as the top Sensex gainer after the Q2 results. SBI Securities said that it expects Tech Mahindra stock to outperform the broader IT sector and peers.

items.title: Nestle India shares tank 9% in 2 days as firm flags inflation risks in Q2
items.description: Analysts said that Nestle India's sales growth is expected to be optically lower in H2FY27 vs H1FY27, which is more due to the base effect and not led by any deterioration in the fundamentals.

items.title: Wipro shares gain nearly 2% after Q2 results; brokerages remain bearish
items.description: Wipro's net profit fell 1.4 per cent year-on-year to ₹3,201 crore in the second quarter of financial year 2027.

items.title: Nifty conquers 20-DMA, now eyes 50-DMA breakout at 23,500: Tech analysts
items.description: Nandish Shah of HDFC Securities expects the 22,776-22,800 resistance band on the Nifty 50 index to now act as immediate support, and sees near resistance in the 23,100-23,150 range.

items.title: Stocks to watch: Jio Fin, Yes Bank, Wipro, L&T Fin, Angel One, Urban Co
items.description: Urban Company, Federal Bank, Punjab National Bank, LTM, Bajaj Housing Finance, Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals, DLF, Jindal Saw, Oberoi Realty, Shoppers Stop,  will report Q2FY27 results today.

items.title: Indian Hotels, Oriental Hotels rally up to 6%; what's driving hotel stocks?
items.description: Hotels were impacted in Q1 by the US-Iran conflict; however, analysts at Axis Securities expect a strong Q2, supported by improving metro demand and the BRICS Summit.

items.title: TIPS Music zooms 10% to hit 52-wk high after Q2 nos, ₹6.50/share dividend
items.description: For the July-September quarter, TIPS Music reported a 23 per cent Y-o-Y increase in the profit after tax (PAT) at ₹65.5 crore.

items.title: YES Bank AT-1 bond reinstatement may hit CET1 ratio by 250 bps
items.description: The reinstatement of ₹8,415 crore in AT-1 bonds could reduce YES Bank's CET1 ratio by 250 basis points on a pro forma basis, though its Tier 1 capital ratio would remain unchanged at 14%

items.title: DMart share price hits over 3-year low; down 28% from April high
items.description: The stock price of DMart dipped 1.5% to ₹3,322.90 on Friday, quoting at its lowest level since March 2023. The stock slipped 9% in the past seven trading days.

items.title: Solara Active Pharma share price zooms 16% on Q2 turnaround; H1 net up 103x
items.description: Solara Active Pharma Sciences reported a consolidated net profit of ₹28.59 crore in Q2FY27 and ₹44.70 crore in H1FY27. It posted a loss of ₹9.29 crore in Q2FY26 and profit of ₹0.42 crore in H1FY26.

items.title: Sebi's CAS rule change bigger positive for brokers vs exchanges: Jefferies
items.description: Jefferies said the decision to use the volume-weighted average price (VWAP) to calculate settlement prices of derivatives contracts on expiry days is a bigger positive for brokers than for exchanges.

items.title: Beyond the sell-off: What an MSCI downgrade threat could mean for Indonesia
items.description: Indonesian stocks suffered a massive 11 per cent decline on Friday after MSCI threatened its "emerging market status", which could prompt massive foreign selloff from the Southeast Asian economy.

items.title: Axis Bank Q2 preview: NIM may fall on FCNR(B) flows; PAT could rise 37-43%
items.description: Axis Bank Q2 results preview: The net interest margin may come under pressure in Q2FY27 due to elevated FCNR(B) deposit mobilisation, with analysts projecting a sequential decline of 7-12 bps.

items.title: Zensar, HCL Technologies rebounded from 100-month EMA support, says analyst
items.description: Virat Jagad, technical research analyst at Bonanza, flags that HCL Technologies and Zensar Technologies witnessed buying interest at their respective 100-month exponential moving averages on the chart

items.title: ICICI Bank Q2 Preview: Profit may rise 8-14% YoY, NIM likely to contract
items.description: The bank is slated to post its September quarter earnings this Saturday (October 17) along with several other leading private banking names.

items.title: HDFC Bank Q2 preview: Single-digit PAT growth likely; margin pressure seen
items.description: HDFC Bank Q2 results preview: While deposit growth is expected to be strong, supported by strong FCNR(B) inflows, pressure on margins is seen.

items.title: Senco, PC Jeweller zoom up to 17%; why are gold-related stocks dazzling?
items.description: In Q2FY27, demand remained healthy despite the elevated gold price (up 28% YoY) supported by festive demand, premiumisation and continued market share gains by organised players, analysts said.

items.title: Derivatives volumes may recover after settlement rule changes: Analysts
items.description: Sebi will restore the volume-weighted average price method for expiry-day derivatives settlement from December 7, following trader concerns over sharp price swings

items.title: Better execution, margin gains positive for Bhel despite valuation concerns
items.description: Bhel's Q2FY27 profit surged 119 per cent year-on-year as revenue growth and margin gains beat estimates, while a Rs 2.6 trillion order book supports future growth prospects

items.title: Gold FoFs halt fresh investments before Diwali: What investors can do
items.description: Several fund houses have suspended lump-sum purchases and new investment plans, while existing instalments and redemptions continue.

items.title: India Inc's FY27 profit growth estimates dip 700 bps since February
items.description: Iran war-driven input cost pressures drag FY27 earnings growth forecast to 9.2% from 16.5% in February, while real estate bucks the trend

items.title: Indian IT stocks post best weekly gain in 18 years amid global AI sell-off
items.description: This comes as AI sell-off drives investors towards the country's software firms
